original.target_description: Single experiment, training phase: reaction-time distractor-condition × group-assignment interaction comparing variable-shape singleton detection among uniform nontargets with fixed-shape feature search among heterogeneous nontargets; display sizes five and nine.

n.sample_role: Participants in the training-phase mixed ANOVA (15 per search group); full analytic sample corroborated by F(1,28).
n.exclusions: Correct-response RTs only; trimming above 3.5 within-participant/condition SD removed approximately 1.2% of correct trials. No participant exclusions reported.
n.location: p. 135, Method—Subjects and Results and Discussion; p. 136, Training Phase

es.location: p. 136, Training Phase, distractor condition × group assignment

p.location: p. 136, Training Phase, distractor condition × group assignment

replication.target_description: Experiment 1, training phase: reaction-time distractor-presence × search-group interaction in the 2(search group) × 2(color group) × 2(distractor) × 2(set size) mixed ANOVA. Interaction pools fixed and random color groups; fixed-color planned contrasts separately reproduce the original pattern.

n.sample_role: Participants in the full Experiment 1 training ANOVA, four between-participant groups of 16; F(1,60) corroborates full analytic sample.
n.exclusions: Trials exceeding 2 s (0.8%), anticipations below 0.2 s (less than 0.01%), and within-participant/condition slow outliers above 2.5 SD (typically about 2.7% of trials) excluded. No participant exclusions reported.
n.location: p. 650, Method—Participants, Design and Results; p. 651, Training ANOVA

notes: Original DOI: 10.3758/bf03193824; verified title in Springer full PDF. Replication DOI: 10.1037/xhp0000180; verified title in author-hosted full PDF (University of Geneva). Both cached texts were acquired from these primary PDFs. Original has no precise locator; selected training-phase interaction because neutral description specifies different training display types, rather than identical test displays. Replication p. 651 contains multiple tests; selected analogous training-phase distractor × search-group interaction with requested printed partial eta squared. This replication interaction includes the added random-color manipulation; its n and statistic must not be treated as the fixed-color-only replication subgroup. Authors explicitly report successful fixed-color replication; random colors produce interference also in feature search. Original PDF extraction encodes equals and less-than as control characters; quotes normalize these symbols to = and <. No effect sizes or p values computed or converted.
